input:
; DL6 source catalog as a DL7 userland application, kept self-contained so the
; example reads start to finish in one file.

; Interned(+LogicalType, -SpecializedType) follows the prelude Option shape.
; The replay rule runs while the snapshot exists and materializes ordinary
; rows, which are what remain once the snapshot rows are dropped.
(: Interned
   (* (: source type)
      (: return type)))

(<- (Interned ?Source ?Result)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Source ?Empty ?Arguments)
    (intern Interned ?Arguments ?Result))

(<- (Interned ?Source ?Result)
    (intern_snapshot Interned ?Arguments ?Result)
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons ?Source ?Empty ?Arguments))

(: Repository
   (* (: url text)))

; path and name select the same specialization from two different owners.
; language is the plain-text neighbour that must stay scalar under a policy
; that maps only the wrapper.
(: SourceFile
   (* (: repository Repository)
      (: path (Interned text))
      (: language text)
      (: size int)))

(: Symbol
   (* (: file SourceFile)
      (: name (Interned text))
      (: line int)))

(: SharedTextDictionary (*))

(: CatalogRoot
   (* (: capability "storage-root-v1")
      (: target Symbol)))

; The selection names the WRAPPER as its scalar, so the existing dictionary
; arm claims the field and the existing scalar arm is already excluded.
(: WrappedTextSelection
   (* (: capability "scalar-dictionary-v1")
      (: scalar (Interned text))
      (: dictionary SharedTextDictionary)))

(: PrimitiveTextSelection
   (* (: capability "scalar-dictionary-v1")
      (: scalar text)
      (: dictionary SharedTextDictionary)))

(: SelectivePolicy
   (* (: capability "interned-storage-policy-v1")
      (: root CatalogRoot)
      (: dictionary WrappedTextSelection)))

; Both selections name one authored dictionary, so the dictionary identity row
; is derived twice and must appear once.
(: SharedDictionaryPolicy
   (* (: capability "interned-storage-policy-v1")
      (: root CatalogRoot)
      (: dictionary WrappedTextSelection)
      (: primitive_dictionary PrimitiveTextSelection)))

; Companion artifact: the wrapper-to-underlying-type join, over the existing
; relation. A consumer reads the storage domain and recovers the logical type.
(: Dl6CatalogEmitter (*))

(emits Dl6CatalogEmitter "interned" Interned)
